endpoint.name: Save campaign network settings
endpoint.summary: Save the networks a Sponsored Products campaign targets
endpoint.description: Saves the networks a Sponsored Products campaign targets. Each call replaces the previously saved set; include every network the campaign should target. A campaign_id that does not exist for the advertiser returns 404 with code RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: Osmos generated unique identifier for the onboarded advertiser. Carried as a string per the published SDA v1 contract; the server validates it as a number (non-numeric -> 400).

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Client-facing campaign-group ID. Resolved internally to the backing adgroup ID. Numeric value carried as a string per the published contract; server validates it as a number (non-numeric -> 400).

networks.description: Networks the campaign targets. Each call replaces the previously saved set.

name.description: Name of the network. A network is a retailer serving surface, such as a country-specific site or a storefront of the same retailer.

200.description: Network settings saved. The response echoes the saved networks.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this campaign.

constraints.note: PUT overwrites the campaign's previously saved networks with the networks array in the request. To add or remove a single network, fetch the current set first, modify it, and send the complete list back.
